blocks.html:
This method retrieves a fulfillment set's service zone's details. It sends a request to the
[Get Service Zone](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#fulfillment-sets\_getfulfillmentsetsidservicezoneszone\_id)
API route.

types.name: query
types.description: Configure the fields to retrieve in the service zone.

children.name: fields
children.description:
The fields and relations to retrieve separated by commas.

Learn more in the [API reference](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/store#select-fields-and-relations).

types.name: headers
types.description: Headers to pass in the request.

children.name: tags
children.description:
Tags to cache data under for Next.js applications.

Learn more in [Next.js's documentation](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/caching#fetch-optionsnexttags-and-revalidatetag).

children.name: fulfillment_set_id
children.description: The ID of the fulfillment set this service zone belongs to.

children.name: fulfillment_set
children.description: The fulfillment set this service zone belongs to.

children.name: shipping_options
children.description: The shipping options that can be used in this service zone.

children.name: created_at
children.description: The date the service zone is created.

children.name: updated_at
children.description: The date the service zone is updated.

children.name: deleted_at
children.description: The date the service zone is deleted.
